test_files_modified_during_node: apps/desktop/src/App.test.tsx (the previous test asserted `expect(true).toBe(true)` and proved nothing; replaced with real DOM-driven assertions)
apps/desktop/src/views/views.test.tsx (two tests carried an unused user variable; strengthened to actually drive the interaction)
gate_files_modified_during_node: scripts/validate-generated-pack.py (the dollar-brace rule flagged legitimate TypeScript template literals; now scoped by file suffix, with the negative proof extended to 8 cases covering both false-positive classes and all placeholder shapes)
hardcoded_fixture_risks: apps/desktop/src/data/sample.ts supplies the UI's demonstration content. It is clearly named, confined to the desktop app, and is not presented as sourced content. The UI is not yet wired to the Rust persistence layer.
catch_and_ignore_risks: The exam timer's state setter was declared but never wired, so the countdown never ran; this was caught by the TypeScript unused-variable error and is now a real interval
reason: The desktop UI now has real components, real keyboard-only operation, and 20 Playwright E2E tests against the production dist/ bundle. The vacuous placeholder test was deleted. Test infrastructure that had never existed (jsdom, testing-library, Playwright, and the test:e2e script that scripts/test-e2e.sh already called) was wired up. 91 vitest tests, 20 E2E tests and 23 Rust exam tests pass; 13 of 13 mutations detected.
real_vulnerabilities_found: Playwright could not start the preview server: vite preview bound to `localhost` (IPv6 ::1) while Playwright probed IPv4, producing a 120s startup timeout rather than a test failure. Host is now pinned to 127.0.0.1 on both sides.
scripts/test-e2e.sh called `pnpm test:e2e`, which existed in no package.json, so the E2E gate could never have passed.
known_limitations: The UI runs against sample data and is not yet wired to SQLite through Tauri IPC. No end-to-end claim is made that a learner's real attempts reach the database from the UI.

Several views (onboarding, diagnostic, lesson, explore, evidence, tutor, content, providers) are registered in navigation with an explicit 'delivered by a later node' note; they are reachable and keyboard-operable but their content is not built.

Human accessibility validation (PREFLIGHT PF-017) remains an external gate. Automated checks cover roles, names, keyboard operation and ARIA attributes; they do not replace testing with assistive-technology users.
